name: kip-linker
description: The deterministic Layer-1 entity linker (ADR-B11): given a node inventory of live code:*/doc:* nodes, connects the code and docs islands by returning signed, reversible link edges as an AcquisitionResult (documents edges for concept->code exact identifier matches; same_as pairs for cross-doc same-entity exact matches). Exact whole-string equality only, abstain otherwise (N5); no model, no clock, no random. Reads the graph nothing (INV-A1); only runAcquisition authors its facts.
